adrs.title: Multi-repo over monorepo
adrs.decision: The organization adopts one repository per concern under mastrocola-dev organization, with centralized documentation in docs and per-repository operational documentation.

adrs.title: Public site on Azure Static Web Apps with DNS as code
adrs.decision: The public site is hosted on Azure Static Web Apps free plan with DNS managed by Cloudflare Terraform provider, while content is deployed from a separate www repository using a static deployment token.

adrs.title: Agent language, LLM integration, and RAG decoupling
adrs.decision: The agent is implemented in TypeScript using the direct Anthropic API, with RAG deferred and implemented separately in Python via MCP protocol decoupling.

adrs.title: TypeScript without a build step and MCP server distribution
adrs.decision: TypeScript runs natively on Node 24 without compilation, MCP servers are distributed as sibling checkouts locally or container apps in the cloud, and shared conventions are copied across repositories.

adrs.title: Agent-generated content lives at its source and is read at runtime
adrs.decision: The docs pipeline runs the agent on pull requests touching ADRs and commits the generated index to the same branch, which the site fetches at runtime from raw.githubusercontent.com.

adrs.title: One workload identity per repository and Key Vault as the only secret store
adrs.decision: Each repository has a user-assigned managed identity federated with GitHub OIDC, all secrets move to Key Vault with RBAC, and static secrets are removed from GitHub entirely.

adrs.title: Agent runtime on Functions Flex Consumption with queue-based jobs
adrs.decision: The agent runtime deploys three function apps on Flex Consumption with Service Bus for job distribution, Table Storage for state, and layered abuse controls including rate limiting and daily spend limits.
